invariants.rationale: metadata is dereferenced by method calls, so it must be non-null.
A new HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>> is returned using metadata.clone().
result is constructed via clone, so it should be an instance of HoodieWriteMetadata.
getWriteStatuses() is populated from metadata.getWriteStatuses().collectAsList(), which should not be null if metadata is valid.
By construction: the result collects metadata.getWriteStatuses() as a list and puts it into the returned object.
